items.name: typer
items.title: Typer
items.description: Typing reveal of a text. The full text sits in a visually hidden node from the first render, so assistive tech reads it at once; the visible typed portion is aria-hidden. Reduced or off motion shows the full text immediately. An optional typing-tick sound is silent by default.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The typing reveal is plain DOM text updated on a timer; the tick is a synthesized WebAudio cue. No original assets are used. v4 migration: the root is now an inline-grid. An invisible full-text copy (caret included) shares the grid cell with the typed text, so the box is its final size from the first frame; code that measured the growing height or styled the root as inline-block should drop that. New `caret` prop (default true) renders the `yorha-caret` block caret; `data-blink` is set only when the reveal is done and motion is full.
